title: VANA Group 3 Field Observation
description: The frozen 13-field field observation contract produced by Group 3 (Field & Edge Systems) for ingestion into the Group 1 canonical VANA record. Version 1.0, frozen 2026-08-13. Source: Thane Creek Mapping Plan (Suraj Surve, Group 3 Lead) and Field Mission SOP revision 2026-08-13 (Arya Barge).

observation_id.description: Composite identity per the Group 3 Lead's mission plan: Survey + Zone + Flight + Sensor + Observation sequence. The identity of an observation is the whole tuple INCLUDING timestamp and coordinates - do not treat the OBS### fragment as unique on its own.

zone_id.description: One of the eight mapped zones Z1-Z8.

observation_seq.description: Sequence within the flight. NOT globally unique on its own.

device_id.description: Stable identifier of the physical capturing device, issued by the Group 3 device register and intended for registration in the existing Capability Registry under capability_type 'edge_robotics'.

timestamp.description: Time of capture, ISO-8601 UTC. MANDATORY. If the clock cannot be trusted the observation must carry quality_status UNCERTAIN - a time is never invented.

latitude.description: Decimal degrees, WGS84 / EPSG:4326. MANDATORY. Null is permitted ONLY when no fix was obtained, and then quality_status MUST be UNCERTAIN. A coordinate is never invented.

longitude.description: Decimal degrees, WGS84 / EPSG:4326. Same rule as latitude.

measurement.description: The observed value, or a description where the observation is an image or other artifact.

parameter.description: What was measured. Optional but strongly preferred where a numeric measurement exists.

unit.description: Unit for numeric measurements. Null for image or descriptive observations.

accuracy.description: Known accuracy, otherwise the literal string 'NOT VERIFIED'. NOT null, and never a plausible-looking estimate. As of 2026-08-13 no Group 3 sensor has a stated accuracy figure, so every observation currently carries 'NOT VERIFIED'.

calibration_status.description: As of 2026-08-13 no Group 3 device holds a calibration record, so every observation currently carries 'NOT VERIFIED'.

raw_artifact_reference.description: Pointer to the preserved original. The raw file itself is NOT sent to the canonical store - the record holds the reference. Raw data survives; derived values travel alongside originals, never replace them.

path.description: Path or URI within the mission package.

checksum_sha256.description: Computed at capture where the edge device supports it.

quality_status.description: The field QA verdict. This is the field that makes an observation trustworthy - if it cannot be carried into the canonical model, the QA result is lost at the boundary.

provenance.description: Physical device -> operator -> mission -> raw artifact. Answers: what device produced this, when, where, and which original artifact supports it?

tidal_state.description: PROPOSED, not yet agreed. Thane Creek is intertidal and mudflat extent, shoreline position and water boundary are all survey targets - two surveys at different tidal states can show large apparent change with no ecological change. Included so Group 1 can decide whether the canonical model has a home for it.

trace_id.description: PENDING. Two conventions are currently in circulation across Group 4 and the canonical one has not yet been issued. Group 3 will emit whichever convention Group 4 designates and is deliberately not choosing one.

idempotency_key.description: Derived from observation_id. Group 3 enforces idempotency on its own side using the replay.idempotency_key field already present in the TANTRA execution envelope, rather than assuming the store deduplicates. Re-submitting the same observation must not create a second canonical record.

allOf.$comment: Location rule: if either coordinate is absent, the observation cannot claim to be VALIDATED.

then.$comment: Location and time are mandatory. A missing position marks the observation UNCERTAIN - it is never defaulted and never invented.

allOf.$comment: Unit rule: a numeric measurement requires a unit.
